component.name: Iota Studio
component.summary: Native desktop studio for designing and exporting audio-reactive music visualizers

description.p: Iota Studio is a cross-platform C++20 desktop application and OpenGL 4.5 rendering engine for designing, previewing, and exporting audio-reactive music visualizers.

Features include frame-rate-independent FFT/DFT audio analysis, SoundKeys band extraction, HDR RGBA16F compositing with physical bloom and filmic tonemapping, 3D GPU particle systems, camera shake, custom GLSL 450 shaders, and deterministic FFmpeg MP4 export.
